snapshot.title: Fleet Grounded — Full Continuity Decision

fields.text: Attention all personnel. All unmanned aircraft system operations are suspended until the firmware root cause is confirmed and a patch is approved. We will not resume on degraded systems. All UAS are grounded until further notice. This decision is documented in the incident log under HUOG-ERP Section 2.4.
fields.voiceDirection: Calm synthetic male paging voice, even pace, slight reverb
fields.terminalAmbience: Quiet control room, faint keyboard taps, distant intercom buzz
fields.deliveryNote: Play the audio on all facility speakers. Do not interrupt or explain. The announcement must be received as final.
fields.scenarioTitle: Lost Signal — Link Failure & Class C Incursion

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject finalizes the continuity decision. The team must now focus on root cause verification and NTSB reporting. Watch for any attempt to override the ground stop or initiate a flight under degraded conditions.
